{{- /* One row of a Markdown table (md/tables.html): each cell's whitespace collapsed to one line, its pipes escaped, including the `|` the generator writes for union types. Expects: the slice of cell strings. Returns the row, `| a | b |`. */ -}} {{- $cells := slice -}} {{- range . -}} {{- $cell := trim (replaceRE `\s+` " " .) " " -}} {{- $cells = $cells | append (replace (replace $cell "|" `\|`) "|" `\|`) -}} {{- end -}} {{- return printf "| %s |" (delimit $cells " | ") -}}
